text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after large gains felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on portfolio balance and my plan, not on the pleasure of locking in gains alone.","Several quiet periods and a late run of mixed account returns remind me not to trade on one month’s movement—or let infrequent checking become an excuse to skip a thoughtful review.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should watch for loss aversion and attachment to average cost; I’ll assess each holding’s risks and role in the portfolio rather than avoid a sound decision just because selling feels painful."]}
